nodes.description: Public ERC20 token symbol string storage variable set to "LIB".
Public ERC20 token name string storage variable set to "Libera".
Public token decimals value fixed at 18.
Public total supply, 5000000 * 10**18, assigned at declaration.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint256 tracking approved spending amounts; mutated raw in transferFrom.
Mapping address=>uint256 of token balances; minted to deployer in constructor and mutated in _transfer.
Deployer-only constructor that mints totalSupply to msg.sender and sets symbol/name.
Internal balance-moving routine using SafeMath add/sub and emitting Transfer.
Public override that writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
Public override that forwards msg.sender funds via _transfer.
Public override that checks and decrements allowance with raw subtraction, then calls _transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, allowance owner and spender context.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value; unchecked raw subtraction on the allowance mapping.
address spender argument of approve.
uint256 value argument of approve written into allowance.
address to argument of transfer passed to _transfer.
uint256 value argument of transfer passed to _transfer.
address from argument of transferFrom used as allowance owner and debit source.
address to argument of transferFrom forwarded to _transfer.
uint256 value argument of transferFrom used in allowance check/decrement.
address _from argument of _transfer debited in balanceOf.
address _to argument of _transfer credited in balanceOf.
uint256 _value argument of _transfer controlling the moved amount.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balanceOf key when minting totalSupply in the constructor, tying initial supply to caller identity.
constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
constructor assigns symbol = "LIB".
constructor assigns name = "Libera".
constructor reads totalSupply to mint the full supply.
_from parameter indexes balanceOf for the debit leg of _transfer.
_to parameter indexes balanceOf for the credit leg of _transfer.
_value parameter flows into the SafeMath sub/add applied to balanceOf.
_transfer mutates balanceOf via SafeMath sub/add for sender and receiver.
msg.sender is the owner key in allowance[msg.sender][spender] inside approve.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
approve value is stored directly into allowance[msg.sender][spender].
approve grants spending rights by writing the caller's allowance entry.
transfer calls into _transfer with msg.sender, to and value.
transfer's to argument is passed as the _to of _transfer.
transfer's value argument is passed as the _value of _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance keyed by from and msg.sender.
from parameter is the owner index for the allowance lookup.
value parameter bounds the allowance entry that is checked and decremented.
transferFrom executes the raw allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value subtraction.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the allowance mapping, risking underflow if the require guard is bypassed.
transferFrom forwards from, to and value to _transfer after the allowance update.

normalization_plan.reason: spender only indexes the allowance mapping inside approve and carries no independent semantics.
approve's value argument is directly written into allowance and has no role outside approve.
transfer's to argument exists solely to be forwarded into _transfer.
transfer's value argument exists solely to be forwarded into _transfer.
from is the allowance owner and debit source used only within transferFrom.
transferFrom's to argument is only forwarded to the internal _transfer routine.
value drives the allowance check and the raw unchecked decrement on the allowance mapping.
_from is only consumed as the balanceOf debit index inside _transfer.
_to is only consumed as the balanceOf credit index inside _transfer.
_value is only consumed by the SafeMath arithmetic on balanceOf inside _transfer.
